name: Botanical Radiance Illuminating Serum
subtitle: Triple Vitamin C + Ferulic Acid + Rosehip
description: A concentrated, featherlight glow elixir formulated with stable 15% Vitamin C, organic cold-pressed rosehip oil, and Japanese green tea extract. Fades stubborn hyperpigmentation, tightens pores, and infuses your skin with a dewy, glass-skin luminescence that lasts all day.
ingredients: Aqua (Water), 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (15%), Rosa Canina (Rosehip) Seed Oil, Camellia Sinensis (Green Tea) Leaf Extract, Ferulic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate (Multi-molecular), Glycerin, Tocopherol (Vitamin E), Organic Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin.
howToUse: Dispense 3-4 drops onto freshly cleansed fingertips morning and evening. Gently press into face, neck, and décolletage in upward circular motions. Follow with your favorite moisturizer and SPF 50+ in daytime.

reviews.author: Elena Rostova
reviews.title: Literal magic in an amber bottle!
reviews.comment: Within 10 days of using this serum, my acne scarring softened noticeably and my skin has that signature lit-from-within glow! Non-sticky and smells gently of fresh citrus.

reviews.author: Priya Sharma
reviews.title: Boutique store recommended, now hooked
reviews.comment: The skin specialist at the Glow and Care flagship store recommended this during my consultation. The difference in my texture is remarkable!

name: Velvet Peptide Barrier Repair Crème
subtitle: Ceramide Complex + Squalane + Centella
description: Rich, soufflé-textured restorative moisturizer engineered to fortify compromised moisture barriers. Packed with 5 biomimetic ceramides, pure plant squalane, and soothing Centella Asiatica to banish redness and restore supple plumpness.
ingredients: Water, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Plant-Derived Squalane, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Ceramide EOP, Phytosphingosine, Centella Asiatica Extract, Niacinamide, Glycerin, Carbomer.
howToUse: Warm a dime-sized amount between palms and smooth over face and neck as the final sealing step in your skincare routine. Excellent under makeup.

reviews.author: Chloe M.
reviews.title: Saved my winter barrier!
reviews.comment: Rich without feeling greasy. It calms my dermatitis instantly. Worth every penny.

name: Rose Quartz Clarifying Facial Cleanser
subtitle: Damask Rose Water + Salicylic Acid + Niacinamide
description: A velvety gel-to-foam cleanser that gently melts away impurities, excess sebum, and waterproof makeup without stripping your natural lipids. Enriched with organic Bulgarian rose water and gentle micro-exfoliating salicylic acid.
ingredients: Rosa Damascena Flower Water, Decyl Glucoside, Glycerin, Salicylic Acid (0.5%), Niacinamide (2%), Panthenol, Allantoin, Citric Acid.
howToUse: Lather 1-2 pumps with warm water in your palms, massage gently over damp face for 60 seconds, and rinse thoroughly.

name: Pure Silk Scalp & Hair Strengthening Elixir
subtitle: Golden Argan Oil + Rosemary Extract + Biotin
description: Multi-action restorative scalp and hair treatment oil infused with cold-pressed Moroccan argan oil, French rosemary essential oil, and strengthening biotin peptides. Tames unruly frizz, nourishes hair follicles, and imparts a silky, mirror-like gloss.
ingredients: Argania Spinosa (Argan) Kernel Oil, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Oil, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Tocopherol.
howToUse: As scalp therapy: massage 6-8 drops directly onto scalp 30 mins before washing. As leave-in styling: smooth 2 drops through mid-lengths to ends of towel-dried hair.

name: Hydro-Drench Peony Intensive Hair Mask
subtitle: Keratin Peptides + Murumuru Butter + Lotus Bloom
description: Intensive deep-conditioning hair spa treatment jar that revives brittle, heat-damaged, or colored strands. Infuses deep moisture and seals split ends in just 5 minutes with luxurious botanical peony essence.
ingredients: Water, Cetearyl Alcohol, Astrocaryum Murumuru Seed Butter, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein, Paeonia Albiflora Root Extract, Behentrimonium Chloride, Panthenol.
howToUse: After shampooing, apply generously from mid-lengths to ends. Leave for 5 to 10 minutes, then rinse with cool water.
benefits: Zero frizz even in high humidity

name: Dewy Petal Lip & Cheek Stain Oil
subtitle: pH-Activated Color Bloom + Hyaluronic Plump
description: A glass-shine lip oil that reacts with your skin's natural pH to create a personalized, custom rosy flush. Packed with sodium hyaluronate microspheres to visibly plump lips without tingling or stickiness.
ingredients: Polybutene, Octyldodecanol, Simmondsia Chinensis Seed Oil, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopheryl Acetate, CI 45410 (Red 27), Flavor/Aroma.
howToUse: Glide across bare lips for an instant high-shine tint. Dab lightly onto the apples of your cheeks and blend outward with fingertips.
benefits: Custom flush tailored to your undertone

name: Luminous Mineral SPF 50 Skin Tint
subtitle: Broad Spectrum Zinc Oxide + Niacinamide Glow
description: The ultimate skincare-makeup hybrid. 100% non-nano zinc oxide physical sun protection combined with breathable sheer-to-medium coverage. Blurs imperfections with a radiant, satin-dew finish.
ingredients: Zinc Oxide 18.5%, Water, Isoamyl Laurate, Niacinamide, Squalane, Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499), Mica.
howToUse: Shake well. Apply 2-3 pumps across face using hands, beauty sponge, or brush 15 minutes before sun exposure.
benefits: Zero white cast on all skin tones

name: Sandalwood & Vanilla Cashmere Body Soufflé
subtitle: Whipped Shea Butter + Golden Jojoba + Vitamin E
description: An indulgent, airy whipped body butter jar that melts into skin like warm silk. Warm Mysore sandalwood and creamy Madagascar bourbon vanilla wrap the senses while raw African shea butter deeply replenishes dry limbs.
ingredients: Aqua, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Simmondsia Chinensis Seed Oil, Santalum Album (Sandalwood) Oil, Vanilla Planifolia Fruit Extract, Theobroma Cacao Seed Butter.
howToUse: Smooth generously over damp skin immediately following shower or bath to lock in maximum hydration.

name: Cedarwood & Vetiver Soothing Aftershave Balm
subtitle: Aloe Vera + Witch Hazel + Centella
description: Alcohol-free calming post-shave apothecary lotion engineered for sensitive skin. Neutralizes razor burn, tightens micro-nicks, and leaves a sophisticated aroma of Atlas cedarwood and smoky Haitian vetiver.
ingredients: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Hamamelis Virginiana (Witch Hazel) Water, Glycerin, Cedrus Atlantica Wood Oil, Vetiveria Zizanoides Root Oil, Allantoin.
howToUse: Dispense a nickel-sized amount onto palms and press gently into shaved jawline, neck, and cheeks.

name: The Royal Glow Ritual Luxury Gift Box
subtitle: Full Routine: Cleanser + Serum + Crème + Jade Roller
description: The ultimate gift of self-care. Housed in a hand-crafted embossed emerald and gold keepsake box, this curated 4-piece ritual contains our award-winning Botanical Radiance Serum, Velvet Peptide Crème, Rose Quartz Cleanser, and an authentic dual-ended Jade Facial Roller.
ingredients: Includes complete full-size formulations of Botanical Radiance Serum, Velvet Crème, Rose Quartz Cleanser, and natural certified Xiuyan jade roller.
howToUse: Follow the enclosed ritual guide card for a bespoke morning and evening at-home spa experience.
benefits: Save over 25% compared to individual items
Delivered in luxury velvet-lined gift packaging

reviews.author: Marcus Sterling
reviews.title: The most praised anniversary gift I have ever given!
reviews.comment: The presentation is unbelievable. The gold detailing and box quality feel like a 5-star spa boutique in Paris.

name: Midnight Recovery Bakuchiol Elixir
subtitle: Natural Retinol Alternative + Blue Tansy
description: Supercharged with 2% pure Bakuchiol—a gentle botanical alternative to retinol that speeds up cellular turnover without irritation, peeling, or sun sensitivity. Paired with calming blue tansy for overnight skin renewal.
ingredients: Squalane, Bakuchiol (2%), Tanacetum Annuum (Blue Tansy) Flower Oil, Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Boswellia Carterii Oil.
howToUse: Warm 3 drops in hands and press into clean skin at night before bed. Safe for daily use even on sensitive skin.

name: Eucalyptus & Mint Conditioning Beard Oil
subtitle: Golden Jojoba + Cedarwood + Vitamin E
description: Tames coarse facial hair while hydrating the vulnerable skin underneath. Lightweight formulation prevents beard itch and leaves a clean, crisp aroma of Australian eucalyptus and wild peppermint.
ingredients: Simmondsia Chinensis Seed Oil, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Eucalyptus Globulus Leaf Oil, Mentha Piperita Oil, Tocopherol.
howToUse: Massage 3-5 drops into clean, damp beard from roots to tips using fingers or a boar-bristle brush.

name: Matcha & Green Tea Purifying Clay Mask
subtitle: Ceremonial Matcha + French Green Clay + Centella
description: A velvety detoxifying clay mask jar infused with antioxidant-rich Japanese Uji matcha and pore-clarifying French green clay. Draws out deep congestion and stubborn blackheads without parching or tightening the skin.
ingredients: Kaolin Clay, Montmorillonite (French Green Clay), Camellia Sinensis (Matcha) Leaf Powder, Aloe Barbadensis Juice, Centella Asiatica Extract, Salix Alba Bark Extract.
howToUse: Smooth a generous layer over clean, dry skin avoiding the eye contour. Leave for 10-12 minutes until nearly dry, then rinse with lukewarm water.
benefits: Visibly shrinks appearance of enlarged pores

name: Hyaluronic Dew Essence Toner Mist
subtitle: Quad-Hyaluronic Complex + Chamomile Hydrosol
description: An ultra-fine cloud mist spray packed with 4 molecular weights of hyaluronic acid and organic Roman chamomile flower water. Drenches thirsty cells with hydration and preps skin to absorb active serums 3x faster.
ingredients: Anthemis Nobilis (Chamomile) Flower Water, Glycerin, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Panthenol, Allantoin, Cucumis Sativus Fruit Extract.
howToUse: Hold 8-10 inches away and spritz 3-4 pumps generously across face and neck immediately after cleansing or anytime your skin needs a fresh glow recharge.

name: Awakening Caffeine & Peptide Eye Crème
subtitle: Green Coffee Extract + Acetyl Hexapeptide-8
description: Targeted de-puffing eye treatment jar that visibly lifts and brightens tired under-eyes. Formulated with 3% active green coffee bean caffeine, smoothing peptides, and light-reflecting botanical minerals.
ingredients: Coffea Arabica (Coffee) Seed Extract, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-5, Niacinamide, Squalane, Chrysin, Hyaluronic Acid, Tocopheryl Acetate.
howToUse: Gently tap a grain-of-rice amount around the orbital bone and brow arch with your ring finger morning and evening.
benefits: Lightens genetic and fatigue dark circles
Smoothes crow's feet and fine lines

name: Niacinamide 10% + Zinc Pore Refine Serum
subtitle: Pure Niacinamide + Zinc PCA + Willow Bark
description: A high-potency clarifying serum dropper bottle formulated to normalize sebum production, refine stretched pores, and smooth bumpy skin texture. Fast-absorbing and completely non-tacky.
ingredients: Aqua, Niacinamide (10%), Zinc PCA (1%), Salix Nigra (Willow) Bark Extract, Dimethyl Isosorbide, Ethoxydiglycol, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Phenoxyethanol.
howToUse: Apply 2-3 drops to entire face morning and evening before heavier crèmes. Do not combine in same routine with strong acids.

name: Densifying Rosemary & Rice Water Shampoo
subtitle: Rosemary Hydrosol + Fermented Rice Protein + Biotin
description: A sulfate-free volumizing hair cleanser in an amber pump bottle that builds weightless body while invigorating hair roots. Harnesses centuries-old Yao rice water fermentation and steam-distilled rosemary.
ingredients: Rosmarinus Officinalis Water, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Fermented Oryza Sativa (Rice) Water, Biotin, Serenoa Serrulata (Saw Palmetto) Fruit Extract, Panthenol, Polyquaternium-10.
howToUse: Massage 2 pumps into wet scalp for 2 minutes to stimulate circulation, work through ends, and rinse thoroughly.

name: Velvet Moisture Biotin Conditioner
subtitle: Shea Milk + Sweet Almond Oil + Silk Keratin
description: A silky, weightless detangling conditioner bottle that coats every hair strand with restorative botanicals. Instantly dissolves knots, smooths flyaways, and seals cuticle moisture for high-gloss movement.
ingredients: Aqua, Cetearyl Alcohol, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Oil, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter, Hydrolyzed Silk, Biotin, Cetrimonium Chloride, Fragrance (Natural).
howToUse: Apply to clean, wet hair focusing on mid-lengths to ends. Leave for 2 minutes, then rinse cleanly.
benefits: Enhances natural curl and wave definition

name: Silk Veil Mineral Pressed Setting Powder
subtitle: Finely Milled Rice Starch + Golden Jojoba Esters
description: A luxury gold compact powder with vanity mirror containing micro-fine translucent mineral powder. Blurs pores and softens shine with an airbrushed, soft-focus finish that never cakes or settles into fine lines.
ingredients: Mica, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Starch, Silica, Magnesium Stearate, Simmondsia Chinensis Seed Oil, Tocopherol, Iron Oxides.
howToUse: Swirl a fluffy powder brush into the compact, tap off excess, and sweep across T-zone or entire face to set makeup.

name: Champagne Dew Liquid Radiance Drops
subtitle: Micro-Pearls + Marula Oil + Vitamin E
description: Customizable liquid glow highlighter dropper that imparts a multidimensional champagne sheen. Mix into your daily moisturizer, SPF, or dab directly onto cheekbones, collarbones, and cupid's bow.
ingredients: Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Sclerocarya Birrea (Marula) Seed Oil, Mica, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Tocopherol, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891).
howToUse: Dispense 1 drop for subtle radiance or 2-3 drops for red-carpet beam. Blend with fingers or damp sponge.

name: Neroli & Jasmine Golden Dry Body Oil
subtitle: Sweet Almond + Camellia Seed + Evening Primrose
description: A multi-use dry oil spray bottle that sinks into skin in seconds, leaving arms, legs, and décolletage satin-soft with a luminous sheen. Infused with intoxicating French neroli and night-blooming Indian jasmine.
ingredients: Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Oil, Camellia Oleifera Seed Oil, Oenothera Biennis Oil, Citrus Aurantium (Neroli) Oil, Jasminum Officinale Extract.
howToUse: Spritz over body after bathing while skin is still slightly warm. Smooth gently over hair tips for instant gloss.
benefits: Zero greasy residue on silk clothing

name: Rose Himalayan Exfoliating Salt Body Polish
subtitle: Pink Himalayan Salt + Sweet Almond + Damask Rose
description: A spa-grade body scrub jar packed with mineral-dense pink Himalayan salt crystals buffed in rich sweet almond oil. Gently polishes away dull dry skin, leaving your body baby-soft and delicately perfumed with crushed rose petals.
ingredients: Sodium Chloride (Himalayan Pink Salt), Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Oil, Rosa Damascena Flower Oil, Pelargonium Graveolens Oil, Tocopherol.
howToUse: Scoop a handful in the shower and massage into damp skin using circular motions toward the heart. Rinse thoroughly.

name: Activated Charcoal Clarifying Men's Face Wash
subtitle: Bamboo Charcoal + Australian Tea Tree + Menthol
description: An invigorating black gel cleanser bottle that pulls pollution, heavy grease, and stubborn sunscreen out of clogged pores. Leaves the complexion energized and cooling without stripped tightness.
ingredients: Aqua, Charcoal Powder, Melaleuca Alternifolia (Tea Tree) Leaf Oil, Menthol, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Citric Acid.
howToUse: Lather a pump with water between wet hands, massage over face and neck for 30 seconds, and rinse cold.
benefits: Pulls out gym sweat and deep pollution

name: The Botanical Glow Discovery Travel Set
subtitle: Cleanser 50ml + Serum 15ml + Crème 20ml + Velvet Vanity Pouch
description: A TSA-approved luxury travel set presented in a keepsake emerald green vegan leather vanity case with gold zippers. Contains miniature editions of our 3 best-selling radiance essentials for glowing skin on the go.
ingredients: Includes 50ml Rose Quartz Cleanser, 15ml Botanical Radiance Serum, and 20ml Velvet Peptide Barrier Crème.
howToUse: Complete 3-step morning and evening ritual instructions provided inside the luxury vanity case.
benefits: Waterproof luxury travel vanity case included
Perfect introduction to clean botanical luxury
